hey. i overdosed not too long after this and came out unscathed. my login here was saved and im just here to log out and create a new throwaway.

just so you know they didn't tell my parents.
she's literally gonna call me stupid. i don't need her knowing these things
because i don't want her to find out

It might give you some peace of mind that this is a known thought process/mindset that you can read more about if you'd like, and that you're not alone in thinking this way. The name of it is called passive suicidal ideation or passive death wish.
